title: Parking Enforcement Workers
description: Patrol assigned area, such as public parking lot or city streets to issue tickets to overtime parking violators and illegally parked vehicles.

tasks.text: Enter and retrieve information pertaining to vehicle registration, identification, and status, using hand-held computers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Database queries for investigation details

dwas.name: Use databases to locate investigation details or other information.

tasks.text: Maintain close communications with dispatching personnel, using two-way radios or cell phones.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live radio relay of incidents is real-time human

dwas.name: Relay information about incidents or emergencies to personnel using phones or two-way radios.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Patrol an assigned area by vehicle or on foot to ensure public compliance with existing parking ordinance.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Patrolling properties is embodied mobile work

dwas.name: Patrol properties to maintain safety.

tasks.text: Identify vehicles in violation of parking codes, checking with dispatchers when necessary to confirm identities or to determine whether vehicles need to be booted or towed.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Relaying situation details is structured communication

dwas.name: Locate suspicious objects or vehicles.
Communicate situation details to appropriate personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Write warnings and citations for illegally parked vehicles.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Citations require on-scene judgment and legal authority

dwas.name: Issue warnings or citations.

tasks.text: Appear in court at hearings regarding contested traffic citations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Testimony carries legal accountability and live presence

dwas.name: Testify at legal or legislative proceedings.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Maintain assigned equipment and supplies, such as hand-held citation computers, citation books, rain gear, tire-marking chalk, and street cones.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Supply inventory tracking and reorder largely automatable

dwas.name: Maintain supply or equipment inventories.

tasks.text: Respond to and make radio dispatch calls regarding parking violations and complaints.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live radio relay of incidents is real-time human

dwas.name: Relay information about incidents or emergencies to personnel using phones or two-way radios.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Provide information to the public regarding parking regulations and facilities, and the location of streets, buildings and points of interest.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public communication needs accountability and audience trust

dwas.name: Inform the public about policies, services or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Make arrangements for illegally parked or abandoned vehicles to be towed, and direct tow-truck drivers to the correct vehicles.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Relaying situation details is structured communication

dwas.name: Confiscate prohibited or dangerous items.
Communicate situation details to appropriate personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Observe and report hazardous conditions, such as missing traffic signals or signs, and street markings that need to be repainted.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Environmental hazard detection needs physical sensors

dwas.name: Monitor environmental conditions to detect hazards.

tasks.text: Perform simple vehicle maintenance procedures, such as checking oil and gas, and report mechanical problems to supervisors.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Relaying situation details is structured communication

dwas.name: Communicate situation details to appropriate personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Mark tires of parked vehicles with chalk and record time of marking, and return at regular intervals to ensure that parking time limits are not exceeded.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — GPS/telematics tracking is digital; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Monitor vehicle movement or location.

tasks.text: Prepare and maintain required records, including logs of parking enforcement activities, and records of contested citations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

dwas.name: Maintain operational records.

tasks.text: Investigate and answer complaints regarding contested parking citations, determining their validity and routing them appropriately.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Relaying information needs real-time human channel

dwas.name: Investigate transportation incidents, violations, or complaints.
Relay information between personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

dwas.name: Respond to customer problems or complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Perform traffic control duties such as setting up barricades and temporary signs, placing bags on parking meters to limit their use, or directing traffic or pedestrians.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically blocking access to areas

dwas.name: Block physical access to restricted areas.
Direct vehicle traffic.

tasks.text: Train new or temporary staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live instruction and hands-on coaching require human presence

dwas.name: Train employees in proper work procedures.

tasks.text: Locate lost, stolen, and counterfeit parking permits, and take necessary enforcement action.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Spotting suspicious objects needs physical visual search

dwas.name: Locate suspicious objects or vehicles.

tasks.text: Provide assistance to motorists needing help with problems, such as flat tires, keys locked in cars, or dead batteries.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Roadside physical assistance in unpredictable settings

dwas.name: Assist motorists or pedestrians.

tasks.text: Assign and review the work of subordinates.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People
